title: Characterization of finite fields representing all graphic delta-matroids
statement:
Let $\Gamma$ be a finite abelian group of order at least $2$, and let $\mathbb{F}$ be a finite field. A **$\Gamma$-graphic delta-matroid** is a delta-matroid associated with a $\Gamma$-gain graph; it is **representable over $\mathbb{F}$** when it admits a representation over $\mathbb{F}$. **Complete characterization conjecture.** Every $\Gamma$-graphic delta-matroid is representable over $\mathbb{F}$ if and only if

$$
(\Gamma,\mathbb{F})=(\mathbb{Z}_p^k,\operatorname{GF}(p^\ell))
$$

for some prime $p$ and positive integers $k\leq\ell$. The preceding results establish the sufficiency when $k\leq\ell$ and show that necessity requires $\Gamma$ to be an elementary abelian $p$-group and $\mathbb{F}$ to have characteristic $p$; the conjecture asserts that these conditions, together with $k\leq\ell$, give the complete characterization.
source_name: Donggyu Kim, Duksang Lee and Sang-il Oum, “Γ-graphic delta-matroids and their applications”, arXiv:2104.11383 (2021).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.11383

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2021).
